Euclid's algorithm gives $444111111=3(111444444)+109777779$, $111444444=109777779+1666665$, $109777779=65(1666665)+1444554$, $1666665=1444554+222111$, $1444554=6(222111)+111888$, $222111=111888+110223$, $111888=110223+1665$, $110223=66(1665)+333$, and $1665=5(333)$. The last nonzero remainder is $\boxed{333}$.
